mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.sub_title, p.price, p.promotion_price, p.sale, p.stock, p.detail_desc, b.name AS brand_name, pc.name AS product_category_name, p.new_status, p.recommand_status, p.pic, p.album_pics FROM pms_product p LEFT JOIN pms_brand b ON p.brand_id = b.id LEFT JOIN pms_product_category pc ON p.product_category_id = pc.id WHERE p.publish_status = 1 AND ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.sub_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY p.sale DESC, p.sort DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.sub_title, p.price, p.promotion_price, p.sale, p.stock, p.detail_desc, b.name AS brand_name, pc.name AS product_category_name, p.new_status, p.recommand_status, p.pic, p.album_pics FROM pms_product p LEFT JOIN pms_brand b ON p.brand_id = b.id LEFT JOIN pms_product_category pc ON p.product_category_id = pc.id WHERE p.publish_status = 1 AND pc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{categoryName}, '%') ORDER BY p.sale DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.sub_title, p.price, p.promotion_price, p.sale, p.stock, p.detail_desc, b.name AS brand_name, pc.name AS product_category_name, p.new_status, p.recommand_status, p.pic, p.album_pics FROM pms_product p LEFT JOIN pms_brand b ON p.brand_id = b.id LEFT JOIN pms_product_category pc ON p.product_category_id = pc.id WHERE p.publish_status = 1 AND p.price BETWEEN #{minPrice} AND #{maxPrice} ORDER BY p.sale DESC LIMIT #{limit}
